services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Fly high in the sky, and experience the thrill of soaring through the air! Witness the stunning, panoramic sights of the Gulf of Mexico from way up above. From your view, you’ll float along through a warm ocean breeze and may even catch a glimpse of the incredible wildlife playing in the surf. An exhilarating thrill for the adventurer in you! Sign up for one of the most popular activities to do here at Fort Myers Beach! Hop on your own jet ski, and explore the Gulf with our experienced guides.
